findings.name: Exact action meaning

questions.text: Which immutable definition revision governs the parameters?
Does the host resolve those exact bytes?

findings.artifact: Versioned definition reference, digest and closed parameter schema.
findings.proposedAction: Resolve the pin; reject a digest mismatch or unsupported operation before admission.

findings.name: Proposal has no execution power

questions.text: Who suggested the operation?
Has separate authenticated submission occurred?

findings.artifact: Advisory ProposalEvent and explicit later request context link.
findings.proposedAction: Record the suggestion; require host submission and current execution permission before any effect.

findings.name: Definition lifecycle

questions.text: Is the definition admitted for a first effect now?
What happens after retirement?

findings.artifact: Trusted definition availability record and versioned retirement policy.
findings.proposedAction: Deny new first effects under a retired definition; evaluate replay/read under current policy without re-execution.

findings.name: Intended-operation identity

questions.text: Is this the same intended operation?
Can it be referenced while pending and after completion?

findings.artifact: Immutable ActionRequest object and original SubmissionEvent.
findings.proposedAction: Admit one independent identity; require a new identity for a semantic change.

findings.name: Exact ordered parameters

questions.text: Does reordering labels alter intent?
Which byte rules prevent ambiguous hashes?

findings.artifact: Canonical intent bytes, algorithm version and digest.
findings.proposedAction: Validate closed input; preserve arrays and Unicode code points; compare both bytes and hash.

findings.name: Immutable versus current context

questions.text: Which values describe intent?
Which must be refreshed on each attempt?

findings.artifact: Intent, separate current host decisions and unchanged original admission.
findings.proposedAction: Exclude current decision IDs/times from retry identity; bind actor, principal, target, definition and purpose exactly.

findings.name: Actor and principal

questions.text: Who acts and on whose behalf?
Can a startup use the same party for both?

findings.artifact: Distinct actorId/principalId and trusted session binding.
findings.proposedAction: Match authenticated fixture actor; permit equal roles without manufacturing another party.

findings.name: Bounded direct delegation

questions.text: Does the principal currently have the scope?
Is delegated scope no wider?

findings.artifact: Separate principal/delegate scope records, verified basis reference where used and decision evidence.
findings.proposedAction: Intersect action/resource/purpose/time/audience/Dimension scope; reject unsupported chains and impersonation.

findings.name: Issuer and accountability

questions.text: Who may install scope?
Does an owner or title itself authorize execution?

findings.artifact: Trusted fixture governor, issuer standing and accountable-party reference.
findings.proposedAction: Accept policy changes through the trusted host; retain accountability separately from permissions.

findings.name: Current execution decision

questions.text: Which policy revision permitted this attempt?
Was it current inside the transaction?

findings.artifact: AttemptEvent with nonportable decision evidence and evaluation time.
findings.proposedAction: Re-evaluate after acquiring the write transaction; serialize policy changes with effect commit.

findings.name: Result disclosure

questions.text: May the caller see a cached receipt now?
Do errors expose existence or conflicts?

findings.artifact: Current read decision and sanitized outward response contract.
findings.proposedAction: Check disclosure before revealing receipt, replay, digest or detailed errors; test identical withheld responses across internal states.

findings.name: Revocation and known time

questions.text: Did revocation commit before execution?
Is remote freshness actually guaranteed?

findings.artifact: Local transaction order, policy revision and host freshness limits.
findings.proposedAction: Deny under current local policy; preserve past receipts; do not claim knowledge of unobserved remote revocation.

findings.name: Namespace and key retention

questions.text: Where is the key meaningful?
Can a retired key or request ID be reused?

findings.artifact: Durable key-to-intent mapping and tombstones.
findings.proposedAction: Enforce key and request-ID uniqueness; stop on missing state or unexpected executor epoch.

findings.name: Concurrent delivery

questions.text: Can two attempts commit two effects?
Does retry preserve the original receipt?

findings.artifact: Transactional effect, receipt and attempt log with unique constraints.
findings.proposedAction: Serialize independent connections; commit one effect, retain one receipt and distinct attempts.

findings.name: Resource version

questions.text: Is this a first effect or a retry after later work?
Does the expected revision still apply?

findings.artifact: Original precondition, before/after revisions and retained receipt.
findings.proposedAction: Locate a committed request before checking current revision; require compare-and-set for a new effect.

findings.name: Cancellation race

questions.text: Did cancellation win before effect commit?
Is the request terminal?

findings.artifact: Authorized DispositionEvent in the execution transaction order.
findings.proposedAction: Cancel pending work; reject contradictory receipt/disposition histories and cancellation after effect.

findings.name: Lost response

questions.text: Did the transaction commit despite timeout?
Is absent state actually the latest complete history?

findings.artifact: Original receipt, caller observation and governed continuity evidence.
findings.proposedAction: Perform a fresh authorized read; preserve unknown caller knowledge until reconciled; stop after untrusted restoration.

findings.name: Compensation

questions.text: Which receipt is being compensated?
Has any intervening update occurred?

findings.artifact: New request/key, typed receipt link, before-value and exact prior after-revision precondition.
findings.proposedAction: Re-authorize a new operation; reject cross-resource links, forged receipts and intervening revisions.

findings.name: Receipt versus observation

questions.text: Is this a committed receipt or someone's report?
Does performance prove duty fulfilment?

findings.artifact: Distinct ReceiptEvent and OutcomeObservationEvent with issuer and evidence.
findings.proposedAction: Derive execution state from trusted receipts/dispositions; leave obligation fulfilment to its own process.

findings.name: Corrected knowledge

questions.text: Which earlier observation is corrected, by whom and when?
Does correction alter the effect?

findings.artifact: Append-only same-observer/request chain with retained predecessors.
findings.proposedAction: Validate the full chain; append a correction without replacing observations or receipts.

findings.name: Consistent history

questions.text: Are subjects, pins, attempts, outcomes and clocks consistent?
What proves current completeness?

findings.artifact: Retained native records plus semantic validation report and host continuity context.
findings.proposedAction: Reject orphaned, branched, duplicated or contradictory histories; distinguish archive validity from admission and completeness.

findings.name: Native representation

questions.text: Which record is the request object?
Which occurrences are actual Events?

findings.artifact: Object/Event projections, nested schemas and export manifest.
findings.proposedAction: Validate outer and nested/history contracts; avoid a fake aggregate host or duplicate request-state fact.

findings.name: Adoption and legacy import

questions.text: Can a Task, Contract, WriteGrant or document become executable?
Who authorized conversion?

findings.artifact: Staging/proposal mapping and explicit host submission.
findings.proposedAction: Import as untrusted context; never infer action authority from labels, source priority or past acts.

findings.name: Release and recovery limits

questions.text: Which tests ran?
What must the real host supply, and can an old database be detected?

findings.artifact: Frozen pins, native fixtures, independent audits and continuity runbook.
findings.proposedAction: Publish the implemented audited boundary; retain restore/epoch limits and package verification evidence.

wholeObjectFacets.identity-class: Independent immutable intended operation; unique requestId/key; native object, not an occurrence or grant.
wholeObjectFacets.direct-properties: Definition pin, actor/principal, namespace, target/revision, purpose/deadline, ordered parameters and optional links.
wholeObjectFacets.recognition-observation: Exact admitted canonical bytes and submission; execution state derived from trusted events.
wholeObjectFacets.capabilities-behaviour-actions: Submit once, attempt, cancel pending work, authorized read, compensate by new request; no intent edit.
wholeObjectFacets.context-evidence: Host policy, external definition/basis, admission, resource/receipt history and retention/continuity limits.

wholeObjectFacets.identity-class: Advisory occurrence identified by eventId; no request or permission implied.
wholeObjectFacets.direct-properties: Proposed definition, target, purpose, parameters, suggested principal, proposer and clocks.
wholeObjectFacets.recognition-observation: Recorded suggestion with source and optional predecessor; never execution evidence.
wholeObjectFacets.capabilities-behaviour-actions: Record or supersede through a new advisory event; submission is a separate operation.
wholeObjectFacets.context-evidence: Source material, potential principal and later request link; document instructions are untrusted context.

wholeObjectFacets.identity-class: Original admission occurrence for one immutable request; exactly one per request.
wholeObjectFacets.direct-properties: Request ID, intent digest, admitted definition pin and trusted submission instant.
wholeObjectFacets.recognition-observation: Matches retained request and admitting host; duplicate imports do not make new submissions.
wholeObjectFacets.capabilities-behaviour-actions: Record authenticated admission; cannot itself produce the resource effect.
wholeObjectFacets.context-evidence: Trusted host, canonical bytes and submission policy; archive shape alone proves no admission.

wholeObjectFacets.identity-class: One execution/replay occurrence for an admitted request; eventId, distinct from effect ID.
wholeObjectFacets.direct-properties: Operation, outcome, fresh decision evidence/time and request pin.
wholeObjectFacets.recognition-observation: Distinguished denied/stale/replayed/committed outcomes in retained history; private diagnostics stay private.
wholeObjectFacets.capabilities-behaviour-actions: Attempt under current scope or replay without another effect; no widening or grant issuance.
wholeObjectFacets.context-evidence: Transaction order, current policy, session, definition availability, receipt and disclosure rules.

wholeObjectFacets.identity-class: Unique authoritative receipt of the local effect; native Event plus separate effect identity.
wholeObjectFacets.direct-properties: Before/after revisions and ordered values, request/definition pins and successful attempt.
wholeObjectFacets.recognition-observation: Trusted through the retained transaction; historical value is not current resource state.
wholeObjectFacets.capabilities-behaviour-actions: Authorized read/replay and compensation reference; no overwrite or effect undo.
wholeObjectFacets.context-evidence: Executor, transaction boundary, precondition, retry history and bounded storage assumptions.

wholeObjectFacets.identity-class: Terminal no-effect disposition for pending request; native Event.
wholeObjectFacets.direct-properties: Cancel/expire/precondition reason, request pin, instant and current governance decision.
wholeObjectFacets.recognition-observation: Valid only without receipt and according to serialized lifecycle; deadline acts before materialization.
wholeObjectFacets.capabilities-behaviour-actions: Cancel, materialize expiry or reject precondition; cannot cancel completed effect.
wholeObjectFacets.context-evidence: Trusted host, deadline/resource evidence, authorization and execution race order.

wholeObjectFacets.identity-class: Observer's knowledge assertion, distinct from effect and execution state.
wholeObjectFacets.direct-properties: Reported unknown/success/failure, evidence, observer, clocks and optional corrected Event.
wholeObjectFacets.recognition-observation: Retains known-at history; same-observer chain updates interpretation without erasing records.
wholeObjectFacets.capabilities-behaviour-actions: Append permitted reports/corrections; cannot execute, grant, discharge duty or replace receipts.
wholeObjectFacets.context-evidence: Request, observer provenance, retained predecessor, evidence and admission/disclosure policy.

invariants.text: A ProposalEvent cannot enter the execute path and cannot create a receipt.
Every admitted request has exactly one immutable intent, one namespace/key binding and one original submission.
A reused request ID with a changed key or intent is rejected; a reused key with changed bytes is rejected.
A first effect requires current exact scoped execution permission and a valid half-open deadline inside the local transaction.
Delegated effective scope is a subset of both principal scope and delegate scope; roles and descriptive provenance alone never authorize.
A request has at most one effect ID and one authoritative receipt; concurrent same-key deliveries cannot commit two effects.
The effect, retained deduplication binding and receipt are committed together or rolled back together within the local database.
A replay appends an attempt with fresh decision evidence, preserves the original receipt and cannot overwrite an intervening resource revision.
Current disclosure denial yields no receipt, digest, existence, conflict or replay details, including cached responses.
Policy revocation and cancellation take effect according to the same local transaction serialization order as execution.
An observer correction preserves the targeted history and cannot create, retract or undo an effect receipt.
A terminal disposition and a committed receipt cannot both be authoritative for one request.
Retired keys and request IDs remain tombstoned; missing retained storage cannot silently initialize an empty executor.
Compensation has a new identity/key, a verified prior receipt link, current authorization and a fresh resource precondition.
Native outer schema success never substitutes for nested shape, digest, history, rights or transaction validation.
A declared or imported authority reference cannot change trusted policy or authenticate its own issuer.
